name: obsidian-verse-graph
description: Obsidian plugin that draws the Bible verses your notes cite as a graph.

scripts.version: node version-bump.mjs && git add manifest.json versions.json
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test
scripts.release: npm run check && gh release create "$npm_package_version" main.js manifest.json styles.css --verify-tag --title "$npm_package_version" --generate-notes
